sources.observed: Current Saltrock, Covet & Crave, Connard & Son shopfronts; red terrace four major axes with projecting bays at ends.
Bank southwest oriel tower, three lower gabled canted bays, Wine & Words and vacant east unit.
Leaf-off corroboration of upper window rhythm, ornate brick gable and central rooflets. Historical retail signs not used.

Loaded photogrammetry inspected at headings 0,84.75,171.75,258.75. Red front ridge and unequal rear wings; bank short frontage roof and detached high hall with rectangular hipped lantern across an open court.
Rear hall visible above wall/gated court; most courtyard elevations obstructed. No access into private courtyard.
Venue identifies former Manchester & County Bank entrance and stone coat of arms; 423–427 Lord Street.
Southport BID identifies 2025 opening and address 423–425 next to Connard.
375389847 is joined range, not individual building; Stanley 375391233 is rear bank hall.
